theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1)) (u : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ), Integrable u → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1), X ω = ∫ x, u x * (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) → ∀ h : Eucl (m + 1), ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal |u (x + h) - u x| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ‖h‖ * X.boundary.mass
